name: KauriVPN
relationship: Independent third party (funkemunky / Brighten Development). Its only detection service, funkemunky.cc, is run by the same author.

shipped.note: As downloaded: kickPlayers true, keyless funkemunky.cc lookups (20,000 free queries), results cached in H2.

enforce.note: Enforces out of the box (kickPlayers: true); no step needed.

proxycheck_key.note: No ProxyCheck support: KauriVPN asks only its own service, whose key field (license) is a paid licence. Measured as enforce.

free_keys.note: No ProxyCheck or VPNAPI key fields; the paid funkemunky.cc licence is not a free key. Measured as enforce.

redis_note: No Redis option (H2, MySQL or MongoDB). Redis test not applicable.
telemetry: bStats (bstats: true) - blocked like every product's telemetry
list_sources_note: Downloads no lists; every check is a funkemunky.cc lookup (prefixWhitelists exempts names starting with '*', which no benchmark player uses).
decides_after_join_note: Lets every player in and checks afterwards: 393 of 395 refusals in detection were kicks of a player already on the server (DENY_PLAY). Its join times are the time until it lets the player in, not until it decides.
